scope.text:
Build the 3D stage as isometric SVG (2.5D), not WebGL.

The reference site is flat isometric illustration, not a real 3D engine. SVG gives the same look, runs on school Chromebooks, adds no dependencies, and every hotspot stays a real <button> for keyboard and screen readers.

Timing: these wireframes are the vision for slides and v2. Don't start building them before tonight's 11:30 PM code freeze.

n1.text:
TITLE
• Mission knob: tap or drag to turn, Left/Right arrows on keyboard. 2 positions.
• Rank switch: Cadet 7–9 (no timer) / Commander 10–12 (countdown).
• LAUNCH: 1st tap lifts the cover, 2nd tap launches. Cover closes again after 4 s.
• Idle outpost turns slowly behind the card (stops with Reduced motion).
• SAMPLE DATA banner only when placeholder data loads. Footer never says 'live'.

n2.text:
PLAN A SOL — try it
• Tap Ben in the crew strip, then a teal dot or callout. One astronaut per job; the Shelter holds everyone; unplaced crew rest in the Shelter.
• Taken job → hint 'Pick another station'. Free stations pulse while someone is picked.
• ? on a callout opens the help drawer.
• Stage: drag to pan, rotate in 90° steps (4 pre-drawn views), zoom 75–150%. Labels toggle hides callouts.
• Moving dots: yellow = power, blue = water. Reduced motion stops them.
• Water toast shows when the tank is at 2 or less; red version after 1 thirsty sol.

n3.text:
HELP DRAWER
• Desktop: side drawer 400 px. Phone: bottom sheet, max 85% tall, drag handle.
• Header and close (✕, 44 px) never scroll; only the tab panel scrolls. Fits 1024×572.
• Tabs: What it does / Numbers. Esc and backdrop close it. Focus returns to the ? that opened it.

n4.text:
STORM
• Orange takeover; stage dims; one sun flash (off with Reduced motion).
• Real class in small text + ? explainer.
• Each outside astronaut: Outside → Walking back… → Safe in the Shelter. Rover needs 4 s.
• Commander: ring counts down from 10, '1 second left' singular. Live demo on the first board.
• Time's up stays 2 s on screen, then the Sol result.
• Nobody outside: 'Everyone is already inside. Phew!'

n5.text:
SOL RESULT (new)
• Shows only what changed. Plus in navy, minus in orange, with a word (never colour alone).
• One line per astronaut whose radiation went up.
• NEXT SOL is the only button; Enter works.

n6.text:
MISSION REPORT
• Three endings, three colours and pictures: win = teal, went home = orange, out of time = navy.
• The reason is the headline, in big text.
• Receipt prints line by line (instant with Reduced motion).
• Try again keeps mission and rank.

n8.text:
STATES
• Loading, load error, 3D fallback (flat map, same hotspots), resume prompt after refresh, went-home astronaut, keyboard focus order.
• Every control 44 px or bigger.
